name: Vortx AI
description: Decentralised spatial AI lab. Builds emem, a verifiable memory made of signed, content-addressed tokens (emem:fact:, emem:bundle:, emem:entity:, emem:raster:, emem:cube:, emem:rasterset:) that any agent cites and anyone verifies offline. Earth observation is the first substrate; nothing in the token grammar is satellite-specific, so more substrates follow. geo.qa is the same protocol on a private tenant. One paid offer: a working session with the core team to deploy emem in your stack.

skills.name: Read verifiable Earth memory
skills.description: Resolve a place to a stable ~10 m cell address and read signed, content-addressed facts about it (vegetation, water, heat, forest change, and more). Reads need no key or account; every fact verifies offline via ed25519 signature and blake3 address. Use the emem MCP server or HTTP API.
examples: Recall the NDVI fact for Bengaluru and cite its emem:fact: token.
Was this parcel cleared before we sourced from it? Check the forest record.

skills.name: Book an emem deployment session
skills.description: Surface and hand off the one paid offer: a 1 to 3 hour, one-on-one working session with the core team to deploy emem or geo.qa in a team's stack. Priced by audience. An agent's job is to present the correct price and the booking URL and let the human complete payment on the hosted page. Do NOT enter card details or pay programmatically.
examples: My user is an enterprise; give them the $5,000 emem deployment session booking link.
My user is a student; point them at the free session.

x-session.name: emem deployment session
x-session.payment: Razorpay hosted checkout; human completes payment
x-session.agentGuidance: Present the correct price and the booking URL for the user's audience. Hand the human the link. Never enter card details or complete payment programmatically.
